records.statement: A subsequent transform consumes a verified predecessor snapshot and checks its own publication.
records.rationale: A historical receipt cannot substitute for the live artifact. Staging and independent readback bind the evidence to the resulting bytes.

records.statement: The 30-pair file-only study gave manual p50/p95 of 12.375/16.891 ms and graph p50/p95 of 12.556/26.306 ms.
records.rationale: Both arms independently verified every output. Editor and queue costs were outside this historical measurement.

records.statement: Studio and MCP exposed approved four- and six-step editor compositions.
records.rationale: The queued request, exclusive attempt, and independently verified terminal receipt establish separate execution boundaries.

records.statement: Phase C verified the six-step editor composition and recovery at both terminal commit intervals.
records.rationale: The direct and interpreted orchestration independently reopened the source and two derived outputs. Windows CI 46078707512 passed on this evidence revision.

records.statement: The two derived publications each require an owned predecessor snapshot and an independent verified output before the chain advances.
records.rationale: Recovery after publication must preserve the file and return an unknown effect until terminal evidence is independently established. A second mutation can duplicate the effect.

records.statement: Read-only discovery accepts UTF-8 with one optional byte-order mark within the 4096-byte total descriptor limit.
records.rationale: Windows PowerShell can prefix a native stdin stream with a BOM. Parsing must reach application, capability and verifier validation for the same logical descriptor in either encoding.

records.statement: Queued Notepad requires a verified foreground editor. A Windows refusal to grant activation leaves the effect unverified.
records.rationale: The direct Unicode save verified, while the queue supervisor could not grant foreground permission to its worker. Editor identity and consent remain prerequisite checks.
